Key Responsibilities    Fabricate, assemble and repair metal components and structures used in heavy machinery and industrial equipment.   Operate and maintain ELSA Supercombinata lineboring equipment, facing head and computerised ELSA bore welding system.  Interpret engineering drawings, blueprints and specifications to determine fabrication requirements.   Mark out, cut, shape and form structural steel and metal components using hand tools, power tools and fabrication equipment.   Perform welding using MIG & Bore welder welding techniques to manufacture and repair heavy equipment components.   Carry out line boring preparation, hard facing, gouging and associated fabrication works.  Fit fabricated metal components and ensure correct alignment and tolerances.   Inspect completed fabrication work to ensure compliance with engineering specifications and quality standards.   Perform maintenance and repairs on buckets, booms, pins, bushes, agricultural machinery and earthmoving equipment.   Operate fabrication machinery including presses, grinders, drills, cutting equipment and other workshop machinery safely and efficiently.   Maintain a safe, clean and organised work environment while complying with workplace health and safety procedures.    What We’re Looking For    At least 3 Years of experience operating lineboring equipment.  Supplier approved training Certificate for ELSA lineboring equipment (Highly recommended).  Knowledge and experience on Elsa line boring machines (Highly Recommended).   Australian Recognised Fitter/Welder Trade Certificate (Fitter & welder).  Experience in overlay welding.  Machining of Faces and Flanges.  Demonstrated experience in lineboring welding machine maintenance, repairing components for machinery such as CAT, Liebherr, Sandvik equipment, Hitachi, Komatsu(Velmet), John Deere and Tiger cat.  Display a clear commitment and focus on the health, safety, and well-being of all employees.  Strong interpersonal and communication skills.  Hold a valid Australian Drivers Licence.  Willingness to undertake a Pre-Employment Medical & Drug/Alcohol Screen.      About Company    RiteBore is a small, family-owned, onsite lineboring and welding business based in Bunbury, Western Australia. We  provide onsite Lineboring & Welding, Maintenance, Fitting & Field Service on Agricultural & Earthmoving Equipment  throughout Western Australia, supporting the mining and earthmoving industry. Maintenance Fitter - South Nowra, NSW 
   
 Full-Time Permanent Opportunity | Food Manufacturing | Up to $40/hr base rate + shift loading + Super 
   
 Hays are currently partnering with a well-established food manufacturing business in South Nowra to recruit an experienced Maintenance Fitter to join their Engineering team. 
 This is an excellent opportunity for a trade-qualified fitter who enjoys a hands-on role, working across preventative maintenance, breakdown response, equipment upgrades and continuous improvement projects within a fast-paced production environment. 
 About the Role 
 Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you will join a close-knit maintenance team consisting of Maintenance Fitters and a Maintenance Manager who oversees day-to-day operations. 
 Working across rotating shifts, you'll play a key role in ensuring production equipment operates safely and efficiently while supporting the installation and commissioning of a new manufacturing line. 
   
 Hours: 
 
 Full-time permanent position 
 37.5 hours per week 
 Rotating shifts:
 
 6:00am - 2:00pm 
 11:00am - 7:00pm 
 
 
 Flexibility to work both shifts is essential, although afternoon-focused arrangements may be considered following successful training. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 Carry out preventative and scheduled maintenance on manufacturing equipment 
 Respond to machinery breakdowns, faults, jams and equipment failures 
 Troubleshoot and repair mechanical systems to minimise downtime 
 Assist with machinery installations, upgrades and improvement projects 
 Support the commissioning of a new gummies production line 
 Ensure machinery and components meet Australian safety standards 
 Maintain accurate maintenance records and documentation 
 Promote and follow all workplace safety, GMP and food safety procedures 
 
 About You 
 To be successful in this role, you will have: 
 
 Trade qualification as a Mechanical Fitter or Maintenance Fitter 
 Previous experience working within a manufacturing environment 
 Strong fault-finding and breakdown maintenance capability 
 Experience with preventative maintenance programmes 
 Ability to work both independently and as part of a team 
 Commitment to workplace safety and continuous improvement 
 
 Highly Desirable 
 
 Food manufacturing experience 
 Understanding of GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) 
 Exposure to food safety and quality systems 
 Experience working with automated production equipment 
 Experience commissioning or installing new machinery 
 
 What's on Offer? 
 
 Permanent full-time employment 
 Competitive hourly rate up to $40 per hour + superannuation 
 Stable Monday to Friday roster 
 Opportunity to work on new production line installations 
 Supportive engineering team and leadership 
 Long-term career growth with a successful manufacturing business 
 
     If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV to David.lynes@hays.com.au, or call Dave on 0477551369 now. About the role
We are seeking a dedicated Parts Interpreter for a client to join their team in Brisbane. This is a full-time position based in East and North East of Brisbane QLD , offering an exciting opportunity to work in the automotive trades industry. As a Parts Interpreter, you will play a crucial role in identifying, sourcing, and interpreting vehicle parts information for customers and internal teams. Your expertise will be essential in ensuring accurate parts matching, supporting technical inquiries, and maintaining the efficiency of our operations. This position is integral to our customer service excellence and operational success.

What you'll be doing
Interpreting and decoding vehicle identification numbers (VINs) to identify correct parts specifications
Searching parts catalogues and databases to locate appropriate components for various vehicle makes and models
Providing accurate parts information to customers, mechanics, and internal team members
Cross-referencing parts across different manufacturers and suppliers to ensure compatibility
Assisting in resolving parts-related inquiries and discrepancies
Maintaining detailed records of parts requests and interpretations
Collaborating with sales, warehouse, and technical teams to ensure efficient parts procurement and delivery
Staying current with automotive industry changes, new model releases, and parts nomenclature updates

What we're looking for
Proven experience working as a Parts Interpreter, Parts Coordinator, or similar role within the automotive industry
Strong knowledge of vehicle identification systems and parts cataloguing methodologies
Proficiency in using automotive parts management systems and databases
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in identifying and cross-referencing components
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical information clearly
Capability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple inquiries simultaneously
Problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot parts-related challenges
A valid driver's licence and willingness to engage with the automotive sector professionally
Preferred: Knowledge of multiple vehicle manufacturers and familiarity with common parts categories across different vehicle types

What we offer
Our client is committed to supporting their employees' professional development and wellbeing. They offer a competitive full-time position with the opportunity to develop expertise in automotive parts interpretation. Their team values collaboration, continuous learning, and career progression. They provide a supportive work environment where your technical knowledge is valued and your contributions make a direct impact.

About us
Specialises exclusively in automotive recruitment, backed by over a decade of hands-on industry experience. With 13+ years working within dealerships, we understand workshop pressures, staffing challenges, and the urgency of finding reliable, skilled talent. Our deep industry knowledge and strong candidate network allow us to deliver fast, accurate, dealership-ready hiring solutions. We are passionate about supporting the automotive community and maintaining the highest standards in parts interpretation and customer service.

Ready to join our team? Apply now to advance your career in the automotive trades industry.

Employer questions
Your application will include the following questions:
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have as a parts interpreter?
Do you have a current Australian driver's licence?
